assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless RGB base-color tile for real 3D materials in URMAN, an inhabited Tatar village in winter 2026.
Primary request: one square repeating texture for continuous, intact light warm-grey Soviet-era enamel paint on steel fixtures and furniture in an ordinary village. Slightly softened ivory-grey tone with restrained broad pigment variation and mild age-yellowing from practical use and repairs through 2000–2026.
Style: restrained stylized realism matching URMAN's calm painterly material maps: broad quiet color fields, muted natural palette, readable at game distance, no photographic micro-noise and no extreme grunge. Soviet everyday character comes through the practical institutional finish and color; no cultural pattern or decoration.
Composition: flat perpendicular orthographic surface only, filling the square, evenly balanced with no focal mark. The four edges must tile seamlessly.
Lighting: flat, neutral and even; base-color pigment only.
Avoid: chipped, flaking or pitted paint; exposed substrate; rust; scratches; dirt speckles; holes; plaster or concrete appearance; metal objects; tubes, ribs, borders, hardware; directional shading, shadows, ambient occlusion, highlights, reflections, perspective, text, logos, dates, symbols, watermark, mockup, material ball, collage.
assets.tool: OpenAI built-in ImageGen; native sips used only to normalize output dimensions
assets.purpose: Shared base color for painted steel on village fences and benches, institutional furniture, chair frames and radiators. No geometry, seams, hardware or reflections are baked in.
assets.uv_contract: Opaque square seamless tile on real metric UVs; nominal 1x1 m tile, scale receiver UVs to each passport. Painted coating uses metallic=0; roughness remains a receiver material parameter.
assets.surface_scale: Metric: 1x1 m nominal per tile; use 0.5 m mapping where the receiving passport specifies chair-scale surfaces. Final UV density is not runtime-verified.
assets.visual_check: Viewed at full size and in a 3x3 repeat after export. Calm warm ivory-grey enamel, low-contrast broad variation, plausible maintained Soviet institutional finish; no focal repeat, objects, symbols, baked folds, shadows, highlights or perspective. Slight low-contrast tonal transitions remain visible at enlarged tile boundaries; verify on receiving meshes in runtime. No runtime/import check was run.

assets.prompt:

Avoid: crystalline, cellular, fractured, pebbled or stone-like patterns; visible scratches, oxidation spots, rust, dirt, chips, dents, corrugations, seams, rivets, highlights, shadows, gradients, ambient occlusion, perspective, objects, text, logos, symbols, watermark, mockup, material ball or collage.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a seamless square RGB base-color tile for a muted burgundy seat upholstery material in URMAN's ordinary Soviet village house of culture. Real material: dense matte wool-blend upholstery, well maintained. The color is deep wine-burgundy with restrained warm variation, not vivid red. At normal game distance the surface should read as quiet continuous cloth; show only extremely subtle broad fiber mottling and tiny irregular short-fiber variation. assets.prompt:
